status: grammar spike statuses and hooks; skill modifiers now live in items.json (D-014)

chill.design_purpose: Chill buildup per hit comes from the applying skill; crossing buildup_max freezes. At the spike's numbers a whelp freezes in three orb hits, or two with a top-tier Chill Buildup modifier - a felt breakpoint, not a percentage. Frozen mobs are solid: your damage builds walls. boss_buildup_multiplier is the day-one status-resistance rule so bosses cannot be permafrozen (skill-grammar.md risk list).

shatter.design_purpose: The combo maker: hitting a FROZEN enemy with a trigger skill shatters it - an execute plus a cold nova at the corpse. Novas shatter other frozen enemies in radius, so a frozen train cascades down its own line. Spike-scale execute is safe on fodder; elites and bosses need the execute flag revisited in Wave 2.

design_purpose: The Wave 2 grammar (docs/systems/skill-grammar.md): statuses and on-event hooks. The tag-targeted modifiers that scale them (forks, chill buildup, shatter radius, damage, cooldown recovery) are items.json modifiers since D-014, carried by gear; the F1-F3 debug toggles activate one at its tier-1 maximum. Effect keys: add_* is flat, increased_* sums additively within its bucket, more_* multiplies.
